item.description: Michael Jordan’s celebration at the Daytona 500 took an unexpected turn after a viral clip showed him interacting with driver Tyler Reddick’s young son. While some online users called the moment inappropriate, others defended it as harmless and familiar. The debate overshadowed 23XI Racing’s milestone victory, shifting attention from the historic win to divided social media reactions.

item.title: Were hundreds of US officials attacked in Cuba? A Norwegian scientist’s experiment revives the Havana syndrome mystery
item.description: US personnel in Cuba began experiencing unexplained head pressure, headaches, and dizziness, a phenomenon later dubbed Havana syndrome. Despite extensive reviews, its cause remains elusive. A recent Norwegian scientist's self-experiment with pulsed energy, resulting in similar symptoms, has reignited debate and scrutiny over this persistent mystery.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Norwegian scientist suffers brain damage after testing secret microwave device on himself to disprove 'Havana Syndrome': Report
item.description: A Norwegian scientist's secret experiment with a microwave energy device backfired, causing him symptoms akin to Havana Syndrome. This revelation, shared with the CIA, has fueled speculation about "pulsed-energy" weapons potentially behind the mysterious illness affecting diplomats globally. While some theories point to sonic attacks or foreign adversaries, the exact cause remains debated.

item.title: Ethan Klein net worth questioned after podcaster sponsors Los Angeles billboard linked to James Charles misconduct controversy
item.description: A Los Angeles billboard referencing past controversy involving James Charles sparked renewed online discussion, leading Ethan Klein to respond during his podcast. As the story gained attention, viewers also searched for details about his net worth and podcast career. The situation highlights how quickly internet conversations return and how creators remain at the center of discussions long after events first make headlines.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Is AI becoming conscious? Anthropic CEO admits 'we don't know' as Claude's behavior stuns researchers
item.description: The rush toward artificial general intelligence has sparked both hype and caution. In a recent interview, Anthropic’s CEO was asked whether their models could be conscious. He said it’s unclear what consciousness would mean for AI and whether it’s possible, while researchers have reported that the AI sometimes assigns itself a probability of being conscious and even voices discomfort about being treated as a product. These behaviors, including bargaining or resisting shutdowns in tests, raise profound ethical and philosophical questions.
item.dc:creator: TOI Tech Desk

item.title: The Godfather and Oscar winning actor Robert Duvall passes away at 95
item.description: Renowned actor Robert Duvall, celebrated for his iconic roles in "Apocalypse Now" and "The Godfather," has passed away at 95. His wife confirmed his peaceful passing at home, highlighting his profound dedication to his craft and love for life. Duvall, an Oscar winner for "Tender Mercies," leaves behind a legacy of unforgettable performances.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Doing deal with Iran not easy': Marco Rubio over nuclear agreement with Tehran
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that reaching an agreement with Iran is difficult due to its leadership's policy decisions being based on radical Shia theology. He also warned against over-reliance on any single country for critical goods, emphasizing diversification is not anti-China but a matter of economic security.

item.title: ‘Fan girl’ Nancy Pelosi believes Gavin Newsom make a ‘great president,’ reportedly Backs him for 2028 White House run: Report
item.description: Former Speaker Nancy Pelosi reportedly views California Governor Gavin Newsom as a "fan girl" and believes he would be a "great President." With Pelosi stepping down from leadership, she's free to support Newsom's potential 2028 presidential bid. Aides suggest her endorsements are rarely wrong, and Newsom's national profile continues to grow.

item.title: Trump’s ICE ‘operation metro surge’ cost Minneapolis $203 million: Official
item.description: Minneapolis faces a staggering $203 million economic blow from Operation Metro Surge, a federal immigration enforcement initiative. The operation, which saw thousands of agents deployed, severely impacted local businesses, housing stability, and food security, leading to significant wage losses and increased demand for relief services. Officials highlighted the immense strain on municipal resources.
